result.summary: Do not ship: contract 4 leaks corrected measurement assumptions across subjects, and admission/replay guards accept it. Independently checked 1SAR coordinate statistics, MTZ observations, and retained-log claims matched.

findings.title: Enforce subject ancestry for embedded measurement-assumption replacements
findings.body: Ancestry filtering handles run/headline assumptions but leaves measurement assumptions untouched before this aggregation. In a schema-valid reproduction, a correction targets an assumption embedded in model B’s measurement, with its replacement stored under model A’s measurement. B is excluded from active runs, yet A’s QDS emits the replacement as `status: verified`. Normal live emission, corpus reference checks, and pinned replay all accept it. This transfers subject-specific verification to an unrelated model, violating the correction contract’s isolation requirement.
findings.recommendation: Validate measurement-assumption replacements against their exact target and parent-measurement subject ancestry during projection. Reject or exclude incompatible successors before selection and aggregation.

next_steps: Add the two-subject reproduction as a regression covering live admission, corpus validation, and pinned replay before freezing contract 4.
